calculation.description: Ranks assets by their prior 20-session return divided by the maximum peak-to-trough drawdown observed over the preceding 60 sessions, with a 1 percentage-point stabilizer. Higher values indicate stronger recovery per unit of recent drawdown risk.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 10-day IC in 2020-2022 (+0.049689), 2025-2026 (+0.026013), and 2027-2028 (+0.005102); negative in 2023-2024 (-0.009300) and the short 2029 sample (-0.036823, 38 dates). Interpret the recent negative regime conservatively. Cross-sectional rank IC used 15 tradable benchmark instruments and at least 8 valid names per date.
validation.validation_method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman rank correlation between signal at date t and forward close-to-close return from t to t+10, using only completed observations available at t.

provenance.lookahead_check: Signal uses rolling observations through date t; forward returns begin after t.
